5 /-!
6 # Conditional reward-law source contracts
7 
8 This module records a narrow `COND-EXPECT-REWARD` support leaf.  It packages the
9 remaining generated-policy conditional next-pair law assumption as a reusable
10 contract, then consumes the existing `ConditionalExpectationReward` route.
11 
12 For reward-only generated processes it can now construct the ambient trajectory
13 law and full `partialTraj` source from an initial marginal plus successor
14 `condDistrib` recursion.  It does not synthesize that recursion from a concrete
15 environment or prove a final adaptive bandit theorem.
16 -/
17 
18 universe u v w x
19 
20 namespace BanditRLProof
21 namespace ConditionalExpectationReward
22 
23 open MeasureTheory
24 
25 private theorem eventually_ae_trim_of_eq_measurableSpace
26     {Omega : Type u} {m0 m1 m2 : MeasurableSpace Omega}
27     {mu : @MeasureTheory.Measure Omega m0}
28     (h : m1 = m2) (hm1 : m1 <= m0) {hm2 : m2 <= m0}
29     {p : Omega -> Prop}
30     (hp : Filter.Eventually p (ae (mu.trim hm2))) :
31     Filter.Eventually p (ae (mu.trim hm1)) := by
32   cases h
33   simpa using hp
34 
35 /--
36 The shifted policy-generated action trace whose state reads the finite reward
37 history of the ambient reward trace.
38 -/
39 def generatedActionFromRewardHistory
40     {Omega : Type u} {State : Type w} {Action : Type x}
41     [MeasurableSpace State] [MeasurableSpace Action]
42     (policy : Nat -> Policy.MeasurablePolicy State Action)
43     (state : (n : Nat) -> ((j : Finset.Iic n) -> Rat) -> State)
44     (defaultAction : Action)
45     (reward : Omega -> RewardTrace Rat) :
46     Omega -> ActionTrace Action :=
47   Policy.generatedActionTraceSucc policy
48     (fun n omega =>
49       state n (History.finiteRewardHistoryOfTrace (reward omega) n))
50     defaultAction
51 
52 /--
53 Timewise measurable reward traces plus measurable reward-history state
54 extractors make the generated reward-history action trace timewise measurable.
55 -/
56 theorem generatedActionFromRewardHistory_measurable
57     {Omega : Type u} {State : Type w} {Action : Type x}
58     [mOmega : MeasurableSpace Omega]
59     [MeasurableSpace State] [MeasurableSpace Action]
60     (policy : Nat -> Policy.MeasurablePolicy State Action)
61     (state : (n : Nat) -> ((j : Finset.Iic n) -> Rat) -> State)
62     (defaultAction : Action)
63     (reward : Omega -> RewardTrace Rat)
64     (hreward : forall t : Nat,
65       Measurable (fun omega : Omega => reward omega t))
66     (hstate : forall n : Nat, Measurable (state n))
67     (t : Nat) :
68     Measurable
69       (fun omega : Omega =>
70         generatedActionFromRewardHistory policy state defaultAction reward
71           omega t) := by
72   refine
73     Policy.measurable_generatedActionTraceSucc_eval_of_measurable_state
74       policy
75       (fun n omega =>
76         state n (History.finiteRewardHistoryOfTrace (reward omega) n))
77       defaultAction ?_ t
78   intro n
79   exact
80     (hstate n).comp
81       (History.measurable_finiteRewardHistoryOfTrace reward hreward n)
82 
83 /--
84 For actions generated deterministically from finite reward histories, the
85 finite pair prefix and the finite reward prefix generate the same measurable
86 space.
87 
88 The nontrivial inclusion is that every generated action coordinate through
89 time `n` is measurable from the reward prefix through time `n`; the reverse
90 inclusion is the measurable reward projection from pair histories.
91 -/
92 theorem comap_finitePairHistoryOfTrace_generatedActionFromRewardHistory_eq_comap_finiteRewardHistoryOfTrace
93     {Omega : Type u} {State : Type w} {Action : Type x}
94     [MeasurableSpace State] [MeasurableSpace Action]
95     (policy : Nat -> Policy.MeasurablePolicy State Action)
96     (state : (n : Nat) -> ((j : Finset.Iic n) -> Rat) -> State)
97     (hstate : forall n : Nat, Measurable (state n))
98     (defaultAction : Action)
99     (reward : Omega -> RewardTrace Rat)
100     (n : Nat) :
101     ((inferInstance :
102         MeasurableSpace ((j : Finset.Iic n) -> Prod Action Rat)).comap
103       (fun omega : Omega =>
104         History.finitePairHistoryOfTrace
105           (generatedActionFromRewardHistory policy state defaultAction reward
106             omega)
107           (reward omega) n)) =
108     ((inferInstance :
109         MeasurableSpace ((j : Finset.Iic n) -> Rat)).comap
110       (fun omega : Omega =>
111         History.finiteRewardHistoryOfTrace (reward omega) n)) := by
112   let rewardPrefix : Omega -> ((j : Finset.Iic n) -> Rat) :=
113     fun omega => History.finiteRewardHistoryOfTrace (reward omega) n
114   let pairPrefix : Omega -> ((j : Finset.Iic n) -> Prod Action Rat) :=
115     fun omega =>
116       History.finitePairHistoryOfTrace
117         (generatedActionFromRewardHistory policy state defaultAction reward
118           omega)
119         (reward omega) n
120   apply le_antisymm
121   · have h_rewardPrefix :
122         @Measurable Omega ((j : Finset.Iic n) -> Rat)
123           ((inferInstance :
124             MeasurableSpace ((j : Finset.Iic n) -> Rat)).comap rewardPrefix)
125           inferInstance rewardPrefix :=
126       Measurable.of_comap_le le_rfl
127     letI : MeasurableSpace Omega :=
128       (inferInstance :
129         MeasurableSpace ((j : Finset.Iic n) -> Rat)).comap rewardPrefix
130     have h_pairPrefix :
131         @Measurable Omega ((j : Finset.Iic n) -> Prod Action Rat)
132           ((inferInstance :
133             MeasurableSpace ((j : Finset.Iic n) -> Rat)).comap rewardPrefix)
134           inferInstance pairPrefix := by
135       refine measurable_pi_lambda _ ?_
136       intro j
137       have h_reward_coord :
138           @Measurable Omega Rat
139             ((inferInstance :
140               MeasurableSpace ((k : Finset.Iic n) -> Rat)).comap rewardPrefix)
141             inferInstance
142             (fun omega : Omega => reward omega j.1) := by
143         have h_eval :
144             Measurable
145               (fun history : (k : Finset.Iic n) -> Rat => history j) :=
146           measurable_pi_apply j
147         simpa [rewardPrefix, History.finiteRewardHistoryOfTrace] using
148           h_eval.comp h_rewardPrefix
149       have h_action_coord :
150           @Measurable Omega Action
151             ((inferInstance :
152               MeasurableSpace ((k : Finset.Iic n) -> Rat)).comap rewardPrefix)
153             inferInstance
154             (fun omega : Omega =>
155               generatedActionFromRewardHistory policy state defaultAction
156                 reward omega j.1) := by
157         cases hj : j.1 with
158         | zero =>
159             simp [generatedActionFromRewardHistory,
160               Policy.generatedActionTraceSucc]
161         | succ k =>
162             have hk_le_n : k <= n := by
163               have hj_le : j.1 <= n := Finset.mem_Iic.mp j.2
164               omega
165             let restrictPrefix :
166                 ((q : Finset.Iic n) -> Rat) ->
167                   ((q : Finset.Iic k) -> Rat) :=
168               fun history q =>
169                 history
170                   ⟨q.1, Finset.mem_Iic.mpr
171                     ((Finset.mem_Iic.mp q.2).trans hk_le_n)⟩
172             have h_restrictPrefix : Measurable restrictPrefix := by
173               refine measurable_pi_lambda _ ?_
174               intro q
175               exact measurable_pi_apply _
176             have h_smallPrefix :
177                 @Measurable Omega ((q : Finset.Iic k) -> Rat)
178                   ((inferInstance :
179                     MeasurableSpace ((q : Finset.Iic n) -> Rat)).comap
180                       rewardPrefix)
181                   inferInstance
182                   (fun omega : Omega =>
183                     History.finiteRewardHistoryOfTrace (reward omega) k) := by
184               simpa [restrictPrefix, rewardPrefix,
185                 History.finiteRewardHistoryOfTrace, Function.comp_def] using
186                 h_restrictPrefix.comp h_rewardPrefix
187             have h_state :
188                 @Measurable Omega State
189                   ((inferInstance :
190                     MeasurableSpace ((q : Finset.Iic n) -> Rat)).comap
191                       rewardPrefix)
192                   inferInstance
193                   (fun omega : Omega =>
194                     state k
195                       (History.finiteRewardHistoryOfTrace (reward omega) k)) :=
196               (hstate k).comp h_smallPrefix
197             have h_action :=
198               Policy.measurable_action_of_measurable_state
199                 (policy k)
200                 (fun omega : Omega =>
201                   state k
202                     (History.finiteRewardHistoryOfTrace (reward omega) k))
203                 h_state
204             simpa [generatedActionFromRewardHistory,
205               Policy.generatedActionTraceSucc, hj] using h_action
206       simpa [pairPrefix, History.finitePairHistoryOfTrace] using
207         h_action_coord.prod h_reward_coord
208     exact h_pairPrefix.comap_le
209   · have h_pairPrefix :
210         @Measurable Omega ((j : Finset.Iic n) -> Prod Action Rat)
211           ((inferInstance :
212             MeasurableSpace
213               ((j : Finset.Iic n) -> Prod Action Rat)).comap pairPrefix)
214           inferInstance pairPrefix :=
215       Measurable.of_comap_le le_rfl
216     letI : MeasurableSpace Omega :=
217       (inferInstance :
218         MeasurableSpace ((j : Finset.Iic n) -> Prod Action Rat)).comap
219           pairPrefix
220     have h_rewardPrefix :
221         @Measurable Omega ((j : Finset.Iic n) -> Rat)
222           ((inferInstance :
223             MeasurableSpace
224               ((j : Finset.Iic n) -> Prod Action Rat)).comap pairPrefix)
225           inferInstance rewardPrefix := by
226       have h_projection :=
227         (History.measurable_pairHistoryRewardProjection
228           (Action := Action) (Reward := Rat) n).comp h_pairPrefix
229       simpa [pairPrefix, rewardPrefix,
230         History.pairHistoryRewardProjection_finitePairHistoryOfTrace] using
231         h_projection
232     exact h_rewardPrefix.comap_le
233 
234 /--
235 The shifted generated action/reward history filtration is therefore exactly
236 the comap of the finite reward prefix.
237 
238 This removes the generated action coordinates from the conditioning surface
239 without changing the filtration.
240 -/
241 theorem historyFiltrationSucc_generatedActionFromRewardHistory_eq_comap_finiteRewardHistoryOfTrace
242     {Omega : Type u} {State : Type w} {Action : Type x}
243     [mOmega : MeasurableSpace Omega]
244     [MeasurableSpace State] [MeasurableSpace Action]
245     [MeasurableSingletonClass Action] [Countable Action]
246     (policy : Nat -> Policy.MeasurablePolicy State Action)
247     (state : (n : Nat) -> ((j : Finset.Iic n) -> Rat) -> State)
248     (hstate : forall n : Nat, Measurable (state n))
249     (defaultAction : Action)
250     (reward : Omega -> RewardTrace Rat)
251     (hreward : forall t : Nat,
252       Measurable (fun omega : Omega => reward omega t))
253     (n : Nat) :
254     ((History.historyFiltrationSucc (mOmega := mOmega)
255         (generatedActionFromRewardHistory policy state defaultAction reward)
256         reward
257         (generatedActionFromRewardHistory_measurable
258           (mOmega := mOmega) (policy := policy) (state := state)
259           (defaultAction := defaultAction) (reward := reward)
260           hreward hstate)
261         hreward) n : MeasurableSpace Omega) =
262       ((inferInstance :
263         MeasurableSpace ((j : Finset.Iic n) -> Rat)).comap
264         (fun omega : Omega =>
265           History.finiteRewardHistoryOfTrace (reward omega) n)) := by
266   rw [History.historyFiltrationSucc_eq_comap_finitePairHistoryOfTrace
267     (mOmega := mOmega)
268     (generatedActionFromRewardHistory policy state defaultAction reward)
269     reward
270     (generatedActionFromRewardHistory_measurable
271       (mOmega := mOmega) (policy := policy) (state := state)
272       (defaultAction := defaultAction) (reward := reward)
273       hreward hstate)
274     hreward n]
275   exact
276     comap_finitePairHistoryOfTrace_generatedActionFromRewardHistory_eq_comap_finiteRewardHistoryOfTrace
277       policy state hstate defaultAction reward n

279 /--
280 The generated action at time `i + 1` is measurable with respect to the
281 generated history filtration at time `i`.
282 
283 This is the predictable-action surface needed to mask successor rewards by a
284 fixed arm before applying conditional concentration.
285 -/
286 theorem generatedActionFromRewardHistory_succ_measurable_historyFiltrationSucc
287     {Omega : Type u} {State : Type w} {Action : Type x}
288     [mOmega : MeasurableSpace Omega]
289     [MeasurableSpace State] [MeasurableSpace Action]
290     [MeasurableSingletonClass Action] [Countable Action]
291     (policy : Nat -> Policy.MeasurablePolicy State Action)
292     (state : (n : Nat) -> ((j : Finset.Iic n) -> Rat) -> State)
293     (hstate : forall n : Nat, Measurable (state n))
294     (defaultAction : Action)
295     (reward : Omega -> RewardTrace Rat)
296     (hreward : forall t : Nat,
297       Measurable (fun omega : Omega => reward omega t))
298     (i : Nat) :
299     @Measurable Omega Action
300       ((History.historyFiltrationSucc (mOmega := mOmega)
301         (generatedActionFromRewardHistory policy state defaultAction reward)
302         reward
303         (generatedActionFromRewardHistory_measurable
304           (mOmega := mOmega) (policy := policy) (state := state)
305           (defaultAction := defaultAction) (reward := reward)
306           hreward hstate)
307         hreward) i)
308       inferInstance
309       (fun omega : Omega =>
310         generatedActionFromRewardHistory policy state defaultAction reward
311           omega (i + 1)) := by
312   rw [historyFiltrationSucc_generatedActionFromRewardHistory_eq_comap_finiteRewardHistoryOfTrace
313     (mOmega := mOmega) policy state hstate defaultAction reward hreward i]
314   let rewardPrefix : Omega -> ((j : Finset.Iic i) -> Rat) :=
315     fun omega => History.finiteRewardHistoryOfTrace (reward omega) i
316   have hprefix :
317       @Measurable Omega ((j : Finset.Iic i) -> Rat)
318         ((inferInstance : MeasurableSpace ((j : Finset.Iic i) -> Rat)).comap
319           rewardPrefix)
320         inferInstance rewardPrefix :=
321     Measurable.of_comap_le le_rfl
322   have hselected :
323       @Measurable Omega Action
324         ((inferInstance : MeasurableSpace ((j : Finset.Iic i) -> Rat)).comap
325           rewardPrefix)
326         inferInstance
327         (fun omega : Omega =>
328           (policy i).action (state i (rewardPrefix omega))) :=
329     (policy i).measurable_action.comp ((hstate i).comp hprefix)
330   simpa [generatedActionFromRewardHistory, Policy.generatedActionTraceSucc,
331     rewardPrefix] using hselected

333 /--
334 Canonical reward-only `trajMeasure` selected-reward law on the generated
335 finite-pair conditioning surface.
336 
337 The underlying trajectory contains only reward coordinates.  The previous
338 comap equality shows that adjoining the deterministically generated policy
339 actions to each finite prefix does not change the conditioning measurable
340 space, so the canonical reward-only law can be stated directly in the same
341 finite-pair notation used by the ambient source contracts.
342 -/
343 theorem historyStepKernelFamily_selectedMeasure_condExpKernel_map_trajMeasure_generatedActionFromRewardHistory_finitePairHistoryOfTrace
344     {Context : Type v} {State : Type w} {Action : Type x}
345     [MeasurableSpace Context] [MeasurableSpace State]
346     [MeasurableSpace Action]
347     (mu0 : Measure Rat) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure mu0]
348     (rewardKernel : RewardKernel.MarkovRewardKernel (Prod Context Action) Rat)
349     (policy : Nat -> Policy.MeasurablePolicy State Action)
350     (context : (n : Nat) -> ((j : Finset.Iic n) -> Rat) -> Context)
351     (state : (n : Nat) -> ((j : Finset.Iic n) -> Rat) -> State)
352     (hcontext : forall n : Nat, Measurable (context n))
353     (hstate : forall n : Nat, Measurable (state n))
354     (defaultAction : Action)
355     (n : Nat) :
356     let stepKernel :=
357       RewardKernel.historyStepKernelFamily rewardKernel policy context state
358         hcontext hstate
359     let trajMeasure :=
360       ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.trajMeasure
361         (X := fun _ : Nat => Rat) mu0 stepKernel
362     let reward : RewardTrace Rat -> RewardTrace Rat := fun trajectory => trajectory
363     let generatedAction : RewardTrace Rat -> ActionTrace Action :=
364       generatedActionFromRewardHistory policy state defaultAction reward
365     Filter.Eventually
366       (fun trajectory : RewardTrace Rat =>
367         @Measure.map (RewardTrace Rat) Rat inferInstance inferInstance
368           (fun y : RewardTrace Rat => y (n + 1))
369           (@ProbabilityTheory.condExpKernel
370             (RewardTrace Rat) inferInstance _ trajMeasure _
371             ((inferInstance :
372               MeasurableSpace
373                 ((j : Finset.Iic n) -> Prod Action Rat)).comap
374               (fun y : RewardTrace Rat =>
375                 History.finitePairHistoryOfTrace
376                   (generatedAction y) (reward y) n))
377             trajectory) =
378         RewardKernel.selectedMeasure rewardKernel
379           (context n
380             (History.pairHistoryRewardProjection
381               (History.finitePairHistoryOfTrace
382                 (generatedAction trajectory) (reward trajectory) n)))
383           ((policy n).action
384             (state n
385               (History.pairHistoryRewardProjection
386                 (History.finitePairHistoryOfTrace
387                   (generatedAction trajectory) (reward trajectory) n)))))
388       (ae trajMeasure) := by
389   let stepKernel :=
390     RewardKernel.historyStepKernelFamily rewardKernel policy context state
391       hcontext hstate
392   let trajMeasure :=
393     ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.trajMeasure
394       (X := fun _ : Nat => Rat) mu0 stepKernel
395   let reward : RewardTrace Rat -> RewardTrace Rat := fun trajectory => trajectory
396   let generatedAction : RewardTrace Rat -> ActionTrace Action :=
397     generatedActionFromRewardHistory policy state defaultAction reward
398   have hcanonical :=
399     historyStepKernelFamily_selectedMeasure_condExpKernel_map_trajMeasure
400       mu0 rewardKernel policy context state hcontext hstate n
401   have hcomap :=
402     comap_finitePairHistoryOfTrace_generatedActionFromRewardHistory_eq_comap_finiteRewardHistoryOfTrace
403       (Omega := RewardTrace Rat)
404       policy state hstate defaultAction reward n
405   dsimp only [reward, generatedAction] at hcomap ⊢
406   rw [hcomap]
407   simpa [stepKernel, trajMeasure, reward, generatedAction,
408     History.pairHistoryRewardProjection_finitePairHistoryOfTrace,
409     History.finiteRewardHistoryOfTrace] using hcanonical

411 /--
412 Trim-a.e. canonical reward-only `trajMeasure` selected-reward law on the
413 generated finite-pair conditioning surface.
414 
415 The trim-aware canonical reward law is first proved on the finite reward-prefix
416 comap.  Deterministically generated policy actions do not enlarge that comap,
417 so the same law holds on the finite pair-prefix sigma-algebra used by the
418 generated selected-reward source contract.
419 -/
420 theorem historyStepKernelFamily_selectedMeasure_condExpKernel_map_trajMeasure_generatedActionFromRewardHistory_finitePairHistoryOfTrace_trim
421     {Context : Type v} {State : Type w} {Action : Type x}
422     [MeasurableSpace Context] [MeasurableSpace State]
423     [MeasurableSpace Action]
424     (mu0 : Measure Rat) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure mu0]
425     (rewardKernel : RewardKernel.MarkovRewardKernel (Prod Context Action) Rat)
426     (policy : Nat -> Policy.MeasurablePolicy State Action)
427     (context : (n : Nat) -> ((j : Finset.Iic n) -> Rat) -> Context)
428     (state : (n : Nat) -> ((j : Finset.Iic n) -> Rat) -> State)
429     (hcontext : forall n : Nat, Measurable (context n))
430     (hstate : forall n : Nat, Measurable (state n))
431     (defaultAction : Action)
432     (n : Nat) :
433     let stepKernel :=
434       RewardKernel.historyStepKernelFamily rewardKernel policy context state
435         hcontext hstate
436     let trajMeasure :=
437       ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.trajMeasure
438         (X := fun _ : Nat => Rat) mu0 stepKernel
439     let reward : RewardTrace Rat -> RewardTrace Rat := fun trajectory => trajectory
440     let generatedAction : RewardTrace Rat -> ActionTrace Action :=
441       generatedActionFromRewardHistory policy state defaultAction reward
442     Filter.Eventually
443       (fun trajectory : RewardTrace Rat =>
444         @Measure.map (RewardTrace Rat) Rat inferInstance inferInstance
445           (fun y : RewardTrace Rat => y (n + 1))
446           (@ProbabilityTheory.condExpKernel
447             (RewardTrace Rat) inferInstance _ trajMeasure _
448             ((inferInstance :
449               MeasurableSpace
450                 ((j : Finset.Iic n) -> Prod Action Rat)).comap
451               (fun y : RewardTrace Rat =>
452                 History.finitePairHistoryOfTrace
453                   (generatedAction y) (reward y) n))
454             trajectory) =
455         RewardKernel.selectedMeasure rewardKernel
456           (context n
457             (History.pairHistoryRewardProjection
458               (History.finitePairHistoryOfTrace
459                 (generatedAction trajectory) (reward trajectory) n)))
460           ((policy n).action
461             (state n
462               (History.pairHistoryRewardProjection
463                 (History.finitePairHistoryOfTrace
464                   (generatedAction trajectory) (reward trajectory) n)))))
465       (ae
466         (trajMeasure.trim
467           (show
468             ((inferInstance :
469               MeasurableSpace
470                 ((j : Finset.Iic n) -> Prod Action Rat)).comap
471               (fun y : RewardTrace Rat =>
472                 History.finitePairHistoryOfTrace
473                   (generatedAction y) (reward y) n)) <=
474               (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace (RewardTrace Rat)) from by
475             rw [
476               comap_finitePairHistoryOfTrace_generatedActionFromRewardHistory_eq_comap_finiteRewardHistoryOfTrace
477                 (Omega := RewardTrace Rat)
478                 policy state hstate defaultAction reward n]
479             exact
480               (History.measurable_finiteRewardHistoryOfTrace reward
481                 (fun t => measurable_pi_apply t) n).comap_le))) := by
482   let stepKernel :=
483     RewardKernel.historyStepKernelFamily rewardKernel policy context state
484       hcontext hstate
485   let trajMeasure :=
486     ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.trajMeasure
487       (X := fun _ : Nat => Rat) mu0 stepKernel
488   let reward : RewardTrace Rat -> RewardTrace Rat := fun trajectory => trajectory
489   let generatedAction : RewardTrace Rat -> ActionTrace Action :=
490     generatedActionFromRewardHistory policy state defaultAction reward
491   have hcanonical :=
492     historyStepKernelFamily_selectedMeasure_condExpKernel_map_trajMeasure_trim
493       mu0 rewardKernel policy context state hcontext hstate n
494   have hcomap :
495       ((inferInstance :
496         MeasurableSpace ((j : Finset.Iic n) -> Prod Action Rat)).comap
497         (fun y : RewardTrace Rat =>
498           History.finitePairHistoryOfTrace
499             (generatedAction y) (reward y) n)) =
500       ((inferInstance :
501         MeasurableSpace ((j : Finset.Iic n) -> Rat)).comap
502         (fun y : RewardTrace Rat =>
503           History.finiteRewardHistoryOfTrace (reward y) n)) := by
504     exact
505       comap_finitePairHistoryOfTrace_generatedActionFromRewardHistory_eq_comap_finiteRewardHistoryOfTrace
506         (Omega := RewardTrace Rat)
507         policy state hstate defaultAction reward n
508   have hreward_le :
509       ((inferInstance :
510         MeasurableSpace ((j : Finset.Iic n) -> Rat)).comap
511         (fun y : RewardTrace Rat =>
512           History.finiteRewardHistoryOfTrace (reward y) n)) <=
513         (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace (RewardTrace Rat)) := by
514     exact
515       (History.measurable_finiteRewardHistoryOfTrace reward
516         (fun t => measurable_pi_apply t) n).comap_le
517   have hpair_le :
518       ((inferInstance :
519         MeasurableSpace ((j : Finset.Iic n) -> Prod Action Rat)).comap
520         (fun y : RewardTrace Rat =>
521           History.finitePairHistoryOfTrace
522             (generatedAction y) (reward y) n)) <=
523         (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace (RewardTrace Rat)) := by
524     simpa only [hcomap] using hreward_le
525   have hcanonicalReward :
526       Filter.Eventually
527         (fun trajectory : RewardTrace Rat =>
528           @Measure.map (RewardTrace Rat) Rat inferInstance inferInstance
529             (fun y : RewardTrace Rat => y (n + 1))
530             (@ProbabilityTheory.condExpKernel
531               (RewardTrace Rat) inferInstance _ trajMeasure _
532               ((inferInstance :
533                 MeasurableSpace ((j : Finset.Iic n) -> Rat)).comap
534                 (fun y : RewardTrace Rat =>
535                   History.finiteRewardHistoryOfTrace (reward y) n))
536               trajectory) =
537           RewardKernel.selectedMeasure rewardKernel
538             (context n
539               (History.pairHistoryRewardProjection
540                 (History.finitePairHistoryOfTrace
541                   (generatedAction trajectory) (reward trajectory) n)))
542             ((policy n).action
543               (state n
544                 (History.pairHistoryRewardProjection
545                 (History.finitePairHistoryOfTrace
546                     (generatedAction trajectory) (reward trajectory) n)))))
547         (ae (trajMeasure.trim hreward_le)) := by
548     simpa [stepKernel, trajMeasure, reward, generatedAction,
549       History.pairHistoryRewardProjection_finitePairHistoryOfTrace,
550       History.finiteRewardHistoryOfTrace] using hcanonical
551   have htransported :=
552     eventually_ae_trim_of_eq_measurableSpace hcomap hpair_le hcanonicalReward
553   change Filter.Eventually _ (ae (trajMeasure.trim hpair_le))
554   filter_upwards [htransported] with trajectory htrajectory

3369               state i
3370                 (History.finiteRewardHistoryOfTrace (reward omega) i)) :=
3371         (hstate i).comp hhistory

3373           @Measurable Omega Action (F (i + 1)) inferInstance
3374             (fun omega : Omega =>
3375               (policy i).action
3376                 (state i
3377                   (History.finiteRewardHistoryOfTrace (reward omega) i))) :=
3378         (policy i).measurable_action.comp hstate_history
3379       have hselected_mean :
3380           @Measurable Omega Rat (F (i + 1)) inferInstance
3381             (fun omega : Omega =>
3382               mean
3383                 (context i
3384                   (History.finiteRewardHistoryOfTrace (reward omega) i))
3385                 ((policy i).action
3386                   (state i
3387                     (History.finiteRewardHistoryOfTrace (reward omega) i)))) :=
3388         hmean.comp (hcontext_history.prodMk hselected_action)
3389       have hreward_real :
3390           @Measurable Omega Real (F (i + 1)) inferInstance
3391             (fun omega : Omega => ((reward omega (i + 1) : Rat) : Real)) :=
3392         (measurable_of_countable (fun value : Rat => ((value : Rat) : Real))).comp
3393           hreward_succ
3394       have hmean_real :
3395           @Measurable Omega Real (F (i + 1)) inferInstance
3396             (fun omega : Omega =>
3397               ((mean
3398                 (context i
3399                   (History.finiteRewardHistoryOfTrace (reward omega) i))
3400                 ((policy i).action
3401                   (state i
3402                     (History.finiteRewardHistoryOfTrace (reward omega) i))) :
3403                 Rat) : Real)) :=
3404         (measurable_of_countable (fun value : Rat => ((value : Rat) : Real))).comp
3405           hselected_mean
3406       have hcentered :
3407           @Measurable Omega Real (F (i + 1)) inferInstance
3408             (fun omega : Omega =>
3409               ((reward omega (i + 1) : Rat) : Real) -
3410                 ((mean
3411                   (context i

3413                   ((policy i).action
3414                     (state i
3415                       (History.finiteRewardHistoryOfTrace (reward omega) i))) :
3416                   Rat) : Real)) :=
3417         hreward_real.sub hmean_real

3420 /--
3421 Masking the successor centered-reward process by selection of a fixed arm
3422 preserves strong adaptedness.

3424 The arm event at successor index `i + 1` is already measurable at filtration
3425 level `i`; monotonicity exposes it at level `i + 1`, where the centered reward
3426 it masks is measurable.

3428 theorem generatedActionFromRewardHistory_armMaskedCenteredRewardSuccProcess_stronglyAdapted
3429     {Omega : Type u} {Context : Type v} {State : Type w} {Action : Type x}
3430     [mOmega : MeasurableSpace Omega]

3432     [MeasurableSpace Action] [MeasurableSingletonClass Action]
3433     [Countable Action]

3444       Measurable (fun omega : Omega => reward omega t)) :

3446       generatedActionFromRewardHistory policy state defaultAction reward

3448       generatedActionFromRewardHistory_measurable

3451         hreward hstate

3454       match t with
3455       | 0 => 0
3456       | i + 1 =>
3457           {omega : Omega | action omega (i + 1) = arm}.indicator
3458             (fun y =>
3459               (((reward y (i + 1) -
3460                 mean
3461                   (context i
3462                     (History.finiteRewardHistoryOfTrace (reward y) i))
3463                   ((policy i).action
3464                     (state i
3465                       (History.finiteRewardHistoryOfTrace (reward y) i))) :
3466                   Rat) : Real))) omega
3467     StronglyAdapted F Y := by

3473       (policy := policy) (state := state)
3474       (defaultAction := defaultAction) (reward := reward)
3475       hreward hstate

3477   let centered : Nat -> Omega -> Real := fun t omega =>
3478     match t with
3479     | 0 => 0
3480     | i + 1 =>
3481         (((reward omega (i + 1) -
3482           mean
3483             (context i
3484               (History.finiteRewardHistoryOfTrace (reward omega) i))
3485             ((policy i).action
3486               (state i
3487                 (History.finiteRewardHistoryOfTrace (reward omega) i))) :
3488             Rat) : Real))
3489   let Y : Nat -> Omega -> Real := fun t omega =>
3490     match t with
3491     | 0 => 0
3492     | i + 1 =>
3493         {omega : Omega | action omega (i + 1) = arm}.indicator
3494           (centered (i + 1)) omega

3498         (policy := policy)

3502         (hstate := hstate)
3503         (mean := mean)
3504         (hmean := hmean)

3510   cases t with

3513   | succ i =>

3516             (fun omega : Omega => action omega (i + 1)) := by

3518           (generatedActionFromRewardHistory_succ_measurable_historyFiltrationSucc
3519             (mOmega := mOmega) policy state hstate defaultAction reward hreward i)
3520       have hpredict_succ :

3531 /--
3532 Ambient Azuma-Hoeffding bound for a recursively specified generated reward
3533 process.
3534 
3535 The initial marginal identifies the ambient measure as a probability measure.
3536 Successor `condDistrib` laws construct the full `partialTraj` source and hence
3537 all conditional MGF witnesses, while generated-history measurability supplies
3538 strong adaptedness.  The sum contains the zero slot followed by centered
3539 rewards at indices `1, ..., n - 1`.
3540 -/
3541 theorem historyStepKernelFamily_centeredRewardSuccProcess_sum_tail_ennreal_of_condDistrib
3542     {Omega : Type u} {Context : Type v} {State : Type w} {Action : Type x}
3543     [mOmega : MeasurableSpace Omega] [StandardBorelSpace Omega]
3544     [MeasurableSpace Context] [MeasurableSpace State]
3545     [MeasurableSpace Action] [MeasurableSingletonClass Action]
3546     [Countable Action] [Nonempty Omega]
3547     (mu : Measure Omega) [IsFiniteMeasure mu]
3548     (mu0 : Measure Rat) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu0]
3549     (rewardKernel : RewardKernel.MarkovRewardKernel (Prod Context Action) Rat)
3550     (policy : Nat -> Policy.MeasurablePolicy State Action)
3551     (context : (n : Nat) -> ((j : Finset.Iic n) -> Rat) -> Context)
3552     (state : (n : Nat) -> ((j : Finset.Iic n) -> Rat) -> State)
3553     (hcontext : forall n : Nat, Measurable (context n))
3554     (hstate : forall n : Nat, Measurable (state n))
3555     (mean : Context -> Action -> Rat)
3556     (varianceProxy : Context -> Action -> NNReal)
3557     (law : RewardKernel.CenteredRewardKernelLaw rewardKernel mean varianceProxy)
3558     (hmean : Measurable (fun pair : Prod Context Action => mean pair.1 pair.2))
3559     (defaultAction : Action)
3560     (reward : Omega -> RewardTrace Rat)
3561     (hreward : forall t : Nat,
3562       Measurable (fun omega : Omega => reward omega t))
3563     (hzeroLaw : Measure.map (fun omega : Omega => reward omega 0) mu = mu0)
3564     (hcondLaw : forall i : Nat,
3565       Filter.EventuallyEq
3566         (ae (mu.map (fun omega : Omega =>
3567           Preorder.frestrictLe i (reward omega))))
3568         (ProbabilityTheory.condDistrib
3569           (fun omega : Omega => reward omega (i + 1))
3570           (fun omega : Omega => Preorder.frestrictLe i (reward omega))
3571           mu)
3572         (RewardKernel.historyStepKernelFamily rewardKernel policy context state
3573           hcontext hstate i))
3574     (varianceCeiling : Nat -> NNReal)
3575     (hvariance :
3576       forall i : Nat, forall history : ((j : Finset.Iic i) -> Rat),
3577         varianceProxy (context i history)
3578           ((policy i).action (state i history)) <= varianceCeiling i)
3579     (n : Nat) {eps : Real} (heps : 0 <= eps) :
3580     let Y : Nat -> Omega -> Real := fun t omega =>
3581       match t with
3582       | 0 => 0
3583       | i + 1 =>
3584           (((reward omega (i + 1) -
3585             mean
3586               (context i
3587                 (History.finiteRewardHistoryOfTrace (reward omega) i))
3588               ((policy i).action
3589                 (state i
3590                   (History.finiteRewardHistoryOfTrace
3591                     (reward omega) i))) : Rat) : Real))
3592     let cY : Nat -> NNReal := fun t =>
3593       match t with
3594       | 0 => 0
3595       | i + 1 => varianceCeiling i
3596     mu {omega | eps <= (Finset.range n).sum (fun t => Y t omega)} <=
3597       ENNReal.ofReal
3598         (Real.exp
3599           (-eps ^ 2 /
3600             (2 * (((Finset.range n).sum cY : NNReal) : Real)))) := by
3601   haveI hmapProbability :
3602       IsProbabilityMeasure
3603         (mu.map (fun omega : Omega => reward omega 0)) := by
3604     rw [hzeroLaw]
3605     infer_instance
3606   letI : IsProbabilityMeasure mu :=
3607     Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_of_map
3608       (fun omega : Omega => reward omega 0)
3609   let action :=
3610     generatedActionFromRewardHistory policy state defaultAction reward
3611   have haction : forall t : Nat,
3612       Measurable (fun omega : Omega => action omega t) :=
3613     generatedActionFromRewardHistory_measurable
3614       (policy := policy) (state := state)
3615       (defaultAction := defaultAction) (reward := reward)
3616       hreward hstate
3617   let F := History.historyFiltrationSucc action reward haction hreward
3618   let Y : Nat -> Omega -> Real := fun t omega =>
3619     match t with
3620     | 0 => 0
3621     | i + 1 =>
3622         (((reward omega (i + 1) -
3623           mean
3624             (context i
3625               (History.finiteRewardHistoryOfTrace (reward omega) i))
3626             ((policy i).action
3627               (state i
3628                 (History.finiteRewardHistoryOfTrace
3629                   (reward omega) i))) : Rat) : Real))
3630   let cY : Nat -> NNReal := fun t =>
3631     match t with
3632     | 0 => 0
3633     | i + 1 => varianceCeiling i
3634   have hadapted : StronglyAdapted F Y := by
3635     simpa [F, Y, action] using
3636       (generatedActionFromRewardHistory_centeredRewardSuccProcess_stronglyAdapted
3637         (policy := policy)
3638         (context := context)
3639         (state := state)
3640         (hcontext := hcontext)
3641         (hstate := hstate)
3642         (mean := mean)
3643         (hmean := hmean)
3644         (defaultAction := defaultAction)
3645         (reward := reward)
3646         (hreward := hreward))
3647   have hzeroMGF :
3648       ProbabilityTheory.HasSubgaussianMGF (Y 0) (cY 0) mu := by
3649     simp [Y, cY]
3650   have hcondMGF :
3651       forall i, i < n - 1 ->
3652         ProbabilityTheory.HasCondSubgaussianMGF
3653           (F i) (F.le i) (Y (i + 1)) (cY (i + 1)) mu := by
3654     intro i _hi
3655     have hmgf :=
3656       historyStepKernelFamily_centeredReward_succ_hasCondSubgaussianMGF_of_condDistrib
3657         mu mu0 rewardKernel policy context state hcontext hstate mean
3658         varianceProxy law hmean defaultAction reward hreward hzeroLaw hcondLaw
3659         i (varianceCeiling i) (hvariance i)
3660     simpa [action, F, Y, cY] using hmgf
3661   have htail :=
3662     Concentration.condSubGaussian_sum_tail_ennreal_of_stronglyAdapted
3663       (mu := mu) (Y := Y) (cY := cY) (F := F)
3664       hadapted hzeroMGF n hcondMGF heps
3665   simpa [action, F, Y, cY] using htail

3667 /--
3668 Canonical reward-only `trajMeasure` Azuma-Hoeffding bound for the finite sum of
3669 successor policy-centered rewards.

3671 The zero initial term aligns the successor conditional-MGF witnesses with
3672 Mathlib's `Finset.range n` tail theorem.  Thus the random sum contains centered
3673 rewards at indices `1, ..., n - 1`, and its proxy sum contains the corresponding
3674 history-selected deterministic ceilings.

3676 theorem historyStepKernelFamily_centeredRewardSuccProcess_sum_tail_ennreal_trajMeasure
3677     {Context : Type v} {State : Type w} {Action : Type x}
3678     [MeasurableSpace Context] [MeasurableSpace State]
3679     [MeasurableSpace Action] [MeasurableSingletonClass Action]
3680     [Countable Action]
3681     (mu0 : Measure Rat) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu0]

3683     (policy : Nat -> Policy.MeasurablePolicy State Action)
3684     (context : (n : Nat) -> ((j : Finset.Iic n) -> Rat) -> Context)
3685     (state : (n : Nat) -> ((j : Finset.Iic n) -> Rat) -> State)
3686     (hcontext : forall n : Nat, Measurable (context n))
3687     (hstate : forall n : Nat, Measurable (state n))
3688     (mean : Context -> Action -> Rat)

3693     (varianceCeiling : Nat -> NNReal)
3694     (hvariance :
3695       forall i : Nat, forall history : ((j : Finset.Iic i) -> Rat),
3696         varianceProxy (context i history)
3697           ((policy i).action (state i history)) <= varianceCeiling i)
3698     (n : Nat) {eps : Real} (heps : 0 <= eps) :
3699     let stepKernel :=
3700       RewardKernel.historyStepKernelFamily rewardKernel policy context state
3701         hcontext hstate
3702     let trajMeasure :=
3703       ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.trajMeasure
3704         (X := fun _ : Nat => Rat) mu0 stepKernel
3705     let reward : RewardTrace Rat -> RewardTrace Rat := fun trajectory => trajectory
3706     let Y : Nat -> RewardTrace Rat -> Real := fun t trajectory =>
3707       match t with
3708       | 0 => 0
3709       | i + 1 =>
3710           (((reward trajectory (i + 1) -
3711             mean
3712               (context i
3713                 (History.finiteRewardHistoryOfTrace (reward trajectory) i))
3714               ((policy i).action
3715                 (state i
3716                   (History.finiteRewardHistoryOfTrace
3717                     (reward trajectory) i))) : Rat) : Real))
3718     let cY : Nat -> NNReal := fun t =>
3719       match t with
3720       | 0 => 0
3721       | i + 1 => varianceCeiling i
3722     trajMeasure
3723         {trajectory |
3724           eps <= (Finset.range n).sum (fun t => Y t trajectory)} <=
3725       ENNReal.ofReal
3726         (Real.exp
3727           (-eps ^ 2 /
3728             (2 * (((Finset.range n).sum cY : NNReal) : Real)))) := by
3729   let stepKernel :=
3730     RewardKernel.historyStepKernelFamily rewardKernel policy context state
3731       hcontext hstate
3732   let trajMeasure :=
3733     ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.trajMeasure
3734       (X := fun _ : Nat => Rat) mu0 stepKernel
3735   let reward : RewardTrace Rat -> RewardTrace Rat := fun trajectory => trajectory
3736   have hreward : forall t : Nat,
3737       Measurable (fun trajectory : RewardTrace Rat => reward trajectory t) := by
3738     intro t
3739     exact measurable_pi_apply t
3740   let action :=
3741     generatedActionFromRewardHistory policy state defaultAction reward
3742   have haction : forall t : Nat,
3743       Measurable (fun trajectory : RewardTrace Rat => action trajectory t) :=
3744     generatedActionFromRewardHistory_measurable
3745       (policy := policy) (state := state)
3746       (defaultAction := defaultAction) (reward := reward)
3747       hreward hstate

3749   let Y : Nat -> RewardTrace Rat -> Real := fun t trajectory =>

3751     | 0 => 0
3752     | i + 1 =>
3753         (((reward trajectory (i + 1) -
3754           mean
3755             (context i
3756               (History.finiteRewardHistoryOfTrace (reward trajectory) i))
3757             ((policy i).action
3758               (state i
3759                 (History.finiteRewardHistoryOfTrace
3760                   (reward trajectory) i))) : Rat) : Real))
3761   let cY : Nat -> NNReal := fun t =>

3763     | 0 => 0
3764     | i + 1 => varianceCeiling i
3765   have hadapted : StronglyAdapted F Y := by

3768         (policy := policy)

3772         (hstate := hstate)
3773         (mean := mean)
3774         (hmean := hmean)
3775         (defaultAction := defaultAction)
3776         (reward := reward)

3778   have hzero :
3779       ProbabilityTheory.HasSubgaussianMGF (Y 0) (cY 0) trajMeasure := by

3782       forall i, i < n - 1 ->

3784           (F i) (F.le i) (Y (i + 1)) (cY (i + 1)) trajMeasure := by

3802 The `Finset.range (m + 1)` sum retains the deterministic zero slot required by

3804 `1, ..., m`.  The strict positivity of `m` is the explicit denominator

3812     [Countable Action]

3815     (policy : Nat -> Policy.MeasurablePolicy State Action)
3816     (context : (n : Nat) -> ((j : Finset.Iic n) -> Rat) -> Context)
3817     (state : (n : Nat) -> ((j : Finset.Iic n) -> Rat) -> State)
3818     (hcontext : forall n : Nat, Measurable (context n))
3819     (hstate : forall n : Nat, Measurable (state n))
3820     (mean : Context -> Action -> Rat)
3821     (varianceProxy : Context -> Action -> NNReal)
3822     (law : RewardKernel.CenteredRewardKernelLaw rewardKernel mean varianceProxy)
3823     (hmean : Measurable (fun pair : Prod Context Action => mean pair.1 pair.2))
3824     (defaultAction : Action)
3825     (varianceCeiling : Nat -> NNReal)
3826     (hvariance :
3827       forall i : Nat, forall history : ((j : Finset.Iic i) -> Rat),
3828         varianceProxy (context i history)
3829           ((policy i).action (state i history)) <= varianceCeiling i)
3830     (m : Nat) (hm : 0 < m) {eps : Real} (heps : 0 <= eps) :
3831     let stepKernel :=
3832       RewardKernel.historyStepKernelFamily rewardKernel policy context state
3833         hcontext hstate
3834     let trajMeasure :=
3835       ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.trajMeasure
3836         (X := fun _ : Nat => Rat) mu0 stepKernel
3837     let reward : RewardTrace Rat -> RewardTrace Rat := fun trajectory => trajectory
3838     let Y : Nat -> RewardTrace Rat -> Real := fun t trajectory =>
3839       match t with
3840       | 0 => 0
3841       | i + 1 =>
3842           (((reward trajectory (i + 1) -
3843             mean
3844               (context i
3845                 (History.finiteRewardHistoryOfTrace (reward trajectory) i))
3846               ((policy i).action
3847                 (state i
3848                   (History.finiteRewardHistoryOfTrace
3849                     (reward trajectory) i))) : Rat) : Real))
3850     let cY : Nat -> NNReal := fun t =>
3851       match t with
3852       | 0 => 0
3853       | i + 1 => varianceCeiling i

3855         {trajectory |
3856           eps <=
3857             ((Finset.range (m + 1)).sum (fun t => Y t trajectory)) / (m : Real)} <=
3858       ENNReal.ofReal
3859         (Real.exp
3860           (-((m : Real) * eps) ^ 2 /
3861             (2 * (((Finset.range (m + 1)).sum cY : NNReal) : Real)))) := by
3862   let stepKernel :=
3863     RewardKernel.historyStepKernelFamily rewardKernel policy context state
3864       hcontext hstate
3865   let trajMeasure :=
3866     ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.trajMeasure
3867       (X := fun _ : Nat => Rat) mu0 stepKernel
3868   let reward : RewardTrace Rat -> RewardTrace Rat := fun trajectory => trajectory
3869   let Y : Nat -> RewardTrace Rat -> Real := fun t trajectory =>
3870     match t with
3871     | 0 => 0
3872     | i + 1 =>
3873         (((reward trajectory (i + 1) -
3874           mean
3875             (context i
3876               (History.finiteRewardHistoryOfTrace (reward trajectory) i))
3877             ((policy i).action
3878               (state i
3879                 (History.finiteRewardHistoryOfTrace
3880                   (reward trajectory) i))) : Rat) : Real))
3881   let cY : Nat -> NNReal := fun t =>
3882     match t with
3883     | 0 => 0
3884     | i + 1 => varianceCeiling i

3886     historyStepKernelFamily_centeredRewardSuccProcess_sum_tail_ennreal_trajMeasure
3887       mu0 rewardKernel policy context state hcontext hstate mean varianceProxy law hmean
3888       defaultAction varianceCeiling hvariance (m + 1)
3889       (eps := (m : Real) * eps)
3890       (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg m) heps)
3891   have hevent :
3892       {trajectory |
3893         eps <= ((Finset.range (m + 1)).sum (fun t => Y t trajectory)) / (m : Real)} =
3894         {trajectory |
3895           (m : Real) * eps <=
3896             (Finset.range (m + 1)).sum (fun t => Y t trajectory)} := by

4599 /--
4600 A generated-policy conditional next-pair law source.
4601 
4602 The action trace is generated by the shifted policy from the reward-history
4603 state, and at each step the conditional law of the random next
4604 `(action, reward)` pair is the selected reward law pushed through `Prod.mk` at
4605 the actual next action.  This is a contract surface: it packages the remaining
4606 law input, but does not prove it from a global trajectory measure.
4607 -/
4608 structure GeneratedActionRandomPairMapSource
4609     {Omega : Type u} {Context : Type v} {State : Type w} {Action : Type x}
4610     [mOmega : MeasurableSpace Omega] [StandardBorelSpace Omega]
4611     [MeasurableSpace Context] [MeasurableSpace State]
4612     [MeasurableSpace Action] [MeasurableSingletonClass Action]
4613     [Countable Action]
4614     (mu : MeasureTheory.Measure Omega) [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure mu]
4615     (action : Omega -> ActionTrace Action)
4616     (rewardKernel : RewardKernel.MarkovRewardKernel (Prod Context Action) Rat)
4617     (policy : Nat -> Policy.MeasurablePolicy State Action)
4618     (context : (n : Nat) -> ((j : Finset.Iic n) -> Rat) -> Context)
4619     (state : (n : Nat) -> ((j : Finset.Iic n) -> Rat) -> State)
4620     (defaultAction : Action)
4621     (reward : Omega -> RewardTrace Rat)
4622     (haction : forall t : Nat,
4623       Measurable (fun omega : Omega => action omega t))
4624     (hreward : forall t : Nat,
4625       Measurable (fun omega : Omega => reward omega t)) where
4626   action_generated :
4627     action =
4628       Policy.generatedActionTraceSucc policy
4629         (fun n omega =>
4630           state n (History.finiteRewardHistoryOfTrace (reward omega) n))
4631         defaultAction
4632   random_pair_map_eq_actual_action :
4633     forall i : Nat,
4634       Filter.Eventually
4635         (fun omega : Omega =>
4636           @MeasureTheory.Measure.map Omega (Prod Action Rat) mOmega inferInstance
4637             (fun y : Omega => (action y (i + 1), reward y (i + 1)))
4638             (@ProbabilityTheory.condExpKernel Omega mOmega _ mu _
4639               ((History.historyFiltrationSucc action reward haction hreward) i)
4640               omega) =
4641           MeasureTheory.Measure.map
4642             (Prod.mk (action omega (i + 1)))
4643             (RewardKernel.selectedMeasure rewardKernel
4644               (context i
4645                 (History.finiteRewardHistoryOfTrace (reward omega) i))
4646               (action omega (i + 1))))
4647         (ae
4648           (mu.trim
4649             ((History.historyFiltrationSucc action reward haction hreward).le
4650               i)))
4651

4658 trace is still required to be the shifted policy-generated trace over finite
4659 reward histories.

13002 /--
13003 A real random variable with an a.e. interval bound has every exponential tilt
13004 integrable on a finite measure space.
13005 -/
13006 theorem integrable_exp_mul_of_mem_Icc
13007     {Omega : Type u} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
13008     (mu : MeasureTheory.Measure Omega) [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure mu]
13009     (X : Omega -> Real)
13010     (lo hi : Real)
13011     (hX : AEMeasurable X mu)
13012     (hbound : Filter.Eventually (fun omega : Omega => Set.Icc lo hi (X omega)) (ae mu))
13013     (t : Real) :
13014     MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun omega : Omega => Real.exp (t * X omega)) mu := by
13015   let B : Real := max |lo| |hi|
13016   let C : Real := Real.exp (|t| * B)
13017   have h_exp_aemeas :
13018       AEMeasurable (fun omega : Omega => Real.exp (t * X omega)) mu := by
13019     simpa using (hX.const_mul t).exp
13020   have h_exp_aestr :
13021       AEStronglyMeasurable (fun omega : Omega => Real.exp (t * X omega)) mu :=
13022     h_exp_aemeas.aestronglyMeasurable
13023   refine MeasureTheory.Integrable.of_bound h_exp_aestr C ?_
13024   filter_upwards [hbound] with omega h_omega
13025   have habsX : |X omega| <= B := by
13026     exact abs_le_max_abs_abs h_omega.1 h_omega.2
13027   have hmul_abs : |t * X omega| <= |t| * B := by
13028     rw [abs_mul]
13029     exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left habsX (abs_nonneg t)
13030   have harg : t * X omega <= |t| * B := by
13031     exact (le_abs_self (t * X omega)).trans hmul_abs
13032   have hexp : Real.exp (t * X omega) <= C := by
13033     dsimp [C]
13034     exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr harg
13035   have hnorm : norm (Real.exp (t * X omega)) = Real.exp (t * X omega) := by
13036     rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos _))]
13037   rw [hnorm]
13038   exact hexp
13039

14016     (context : (n : Nat) -> ((j : Finset.Iic n) -> Rat) -> Context)

14031       (fun omega : Omega =>
14032         @MeasureTheory.Measure.map Omega (Prod Action Rat) mOmega inferInstance

20058     (context : (n : Nat) -> ((j : Finset.Iic n) -> Rat) -> Context)

20084     mean

20103     (source.hcontext i).comp hhistory
20104   have hstate_omega :
20105       Measurable
20106         (fun omega : Omega =>

20124         (fun omega : Omega =>
20125           ((rawReward omega : Rat) : Real) -
20126             ((selectedMean omega : Rat) : Real)) :=
20127     hraw_real.sub hmean_real

20129     Measurable
20130       (fun omega : Omega => ((rawReward omega - selectedMean omega : Rat) : Real))

33552 /-- Number of selections of `arm` among successor coordinates `1, ..., n-1`. -/
33553 def successorArmPullCount
33554     {Action : Type x} [DecidableEq Action]
33555     (action : ActionTrace Action) (arm : Action) (n : Nat) : Nat :=
33556   pullCount (fun i => action (i + 1)) arm (n - 1)
33557 
33558 /-- The successor pull count is bounded by the enclosing process horizon. -/
33559 theorem successorArmPullCount_le_horizon
33560     {Action : Type x} [DecidableEq Action]
33561     (action : ActionTrace Action) (arm : Action) (n : Nat) :
33562     successorArmPullCount action arm n <= n := by
33563   exact (pullCount_le_time (fun i => action (i + 1)) arm (n - 1)).trans
33564     (Nat.sub_le n 1)
33565 
33566 /-- Real reward sum from `arm` among successor coordinates `1, ..., n-1`. -/
33567 def successorArmRewardSum
33568     {Action : Type x} [DecidableEq Action]
33569     (action : ActionTrace Action) (reward : RewardTrace Rat)
33570     (arm : Action) (n : Nat) : Real :=
33571   sumRewards (fun i => action (i + 1))
33572     (fun i => (((reward (i + 1) : Rat) : Real))) arm (n - 1)
33573 
33574 /-- Empirical mean of `arm` over the positive successor pull count. -/
33575 noncomputable def successorArmEmpiricalMean
33576     {Action : Type x} [DecidableEq Action]
33577     (action : ActionTrace Action) (reward : RewardTrace Rat)
33578     (arm : Action) (n : Nat) : Real :=
33579   successorArmRewardSum action reward arm n /
33580     (successorArmPullCount action arm n : Real)
33581 
33582 /--
33583 The zero-initialized fixed-arm masked centered sum is the successor selected
33584 reward sum minus successor pull count times a stationary arm mean.
33585 
33586 Only selected coordinates need identify their centering value with `armMean`;
33587 the centering surface away from the arm is erased by the mask.
33588 -/
33589 theorem armMaskedCenteredRewardSuccProcess_sum_eq_successorArmRewardSum_sub_pullCount_mul
33590     {Action : Type x} [DecidableEq Action]
33591     (action : ActionTrace Action) (reward : RewardTrace Rat)
33592     (center : Nat -> Rat) (arm : Action)
33593     (armMean : Rat)
33594     (hcenter : forall i : Nat,
33595       action (i + 1) = arm -> center i = armMean)
33596     (n : Nat) :
33597     (Finset.range n).sum (fun t =>
33598       match t with
33599       | 0 => 0
33600       | i + 1 =>
33601           if action (i + 1) = arm then
33602             (((reward (i + 1) - center i : Rat) : Real))
33603           else 0) =
33604       successorArmRewardSum action reward arm n -
33605         (successorArmPullCount action arm n : Real) * (armMean : Real) := by
33606   classical
33607   cases n with
33608   | zero =>
33609       simp [successorArmRewardSum, successorArmPullCount]
33610   | succ m =>
33611       rw [Finset.sum_range_succ']
33612       simp only [add_zero]
33613       have hsum :
33614           (Finset.range m).sum (fun i =>
33615             if action (i + 1) = arm then
33616               (((reward (i + 1) - center i : Rat) : Real))
33617             else 0) =
33618           (Finset.range m).sum (fun i =>
33619             if action (i + 1) = arm then
33620               (((reward (i + 1) : Rat) : Real)) - (armMean : Real)
33621             else 0) := by
33622         apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
33623         intro i _hi
33624         by_cases hi : action (i + 1) = arm
33625         · simp [hi, hcenter i hi, Rat.cast_sub]
33626         · simp [hi]
33627       rw [hsum]
33628       change
33629         (Finset.range m).sum (fun i =>
33630           if action (i + 1) = arm then
33631             (((reward (i + 1) : Rat) : Real)) - (armMean : Real)
33632           else 0) =
33633         successorArmRewardSum action reward arm (m + 1) -
33634           (successorArmPullCount action arm (m + 1) : Real) *
33635             (armMean : Real)
33636       rw [successorArmRewardSum, successorArmPullCount]
33637       simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel]
33638       calc
33639         (Finset.range m).sum (fun i =>
33640             if action (i + 1) = arm then
33641               (((reward (i + 1) : Rat) : Real)) - (armMean : Real)
33642             else 0) =
33643           ((Finset.range m).filter (fun i => action (i + 1) = arm)).sum
33644             (fun i => (((reward (i + 1) : Rat) : Real)) -
33645               (armMean : Real)) := by
33646                 rw [Finset.sum_filter]
33647         _ =
33648           ((Finset.range m).filter (fun i => action (i + 1) = arm)).sum
33649               (fun i => (((reward (i + 1) : Rat) : Real))) -
33650             ((Finset.range m).filter (fun i => action (i + 1) = arm)).sum
33651               (fun _i => (armMean : Real)) := by
33652                 rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
33653         _ =
33654           sumRewards (fun i => action (i + 1))
33655               (fun i => (((reward (i + 1) : Rat) : Real))) arm m -
33656             ((((Finset.range m).filter
33657               (fun i => action (i + 1) = arm)).card : Nat) : Real) *
33658               (armMean : Real) := by
33659                 have hsumRewards :=
33660                   (sumRewards_eq_finset_filter_sum
33661                     (action := fun i => action (i + 1))
33662                     (reward := fun i => (((reward (i + 1) : Rat) : Real)))
33663                     (a := arm) (t := m)).symm
33664                 rw [hsumRewards]
33665                 rw [Finset.sum_const]
33666                 simp [nsmul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
33667         _ =
33668           sumRewards (fun i => action (i + 1))
33669               (fun i => (((reward (i + 1) : Rat) : Real))) arm m -
33670             (pullCount (fun i => action (i + 1)) arm m : Real) *
33671               (armMean : Real) := by
33672                 rw [pullCount_eq_finset_filter_card]

33674 /-- The masked constant successor proxy sums to the proxy times pull count. -/
33675 theorem armMaskedVarianceSuccProcess_sum_eq_mul_successorArmPullCount
33676     {Action : Type x} [DecidableEq Action]
33677     (action : ActionTrace Action) (arm : Action)
33678     (sigma2 : NNReal) (n : Nat) :
33679     (Finset.range n).sum (fun t =>
33680       match t with
33681       | 0 => 0
33682       | i + 1 =>
33683           if action (i + 1) = arm then (((sigma2 : NNReal) : Real)) else 0) =
33684       (((sigma2 : NNReal) : Real)) *
33685         (successorArmPullCount action arm n : Real) := by
33686   classical
33687   cases n with
33688   | zero => simp [successorArmPullCount]
33689   | succ m =>
33690       rw [Finset.sum_range_succ']
33691       simp only [add_zero]
33692       rw [successorArmPullCount]
33693       simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel]
33694       rw [pullCount_eq_finset_filter_card]
33695       calc
33696         (Finset.range m).sum (fun i =>
33697             if action (i + 1) = arm then (((sigma2 : NNReal) : Real)) else 0) =
33698           ((Finset.range m).filter
33699             (fun i => action (i + 1) = arm)).sum
33700               (fun _ => (((sigma2 : NNReal) : Real))) := by
33701                 rw [Finset.sum_filter]
33702         _ = (((sigma2 : NNReal) : Real)) *
33703             (((Finset.range m).filter
33704               (fun i => action (i + 1) = arm)).card : Real) := by
33705                 rw [Finset.sum_const]
33706                 simp [nsmul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
